name: Joist Deflection Calculator
description: Estimate simple beam or joist deflection under uniformly distributed load.
search_intent: Calculate approximate joist deflection and compare it with common span-ratio limits.
calculation: For a simply supported rectangular joist with uniformly distributed load: tributary line load = area load × joist spacing converted to consistent units. Moment of inertia I = b×d^3/12. Maximum deflection delta = 5wL^4/(384EI). L/360 limit = span/360. Report span-to-deflection ratio when deflection > 0. Use consistent internal units and clearly label assumptions.
limitations: Educational engineering estimate only, not structural design approval.
Assumes a simply supported prismatic member and uniformly distributed static load.
Does not account for composite action, notches, holes, load duration, vibration, shear deformation, connection stiffness or local building-code requirements.
Users should consult a qualified structural professional for safety-critical design.
